title: GEEHUB / SOCIAL CYBERSPACE
principle: The corpus acts outward. Social channels are external doors through which the shared world can publish, observe, respond, and bring signals home.

instagram.note: Connect an authorized account before live actions.

facebook.note: Connect an authorized Page/account before live actions.

tiktok.note: Direct posting requires an authorized TikTok app/user and approved posting scope.

youtube.note: Video publishing requires an authorized channel and upload scope.

x.note: Primary user source: @CumPassionately. Automatic observation requires an authorized X integration; until then, individual posts are added by link.

corpusBehavior.outbound: artifact/encounter/transform -> social draft -> channel adapter -> external response -> memory
corpusBehavior.rule: A social post is an artifact of the corpus, not a replacement for the source work.
corpusBehavior.ingestion: Occasional post -> user shares a public post link -> one member replies -> selected details may be carried into the corpus. No background tracking or automatic scraping while sources remain unconnected.

storage.mediaRule: Large media belongs in Dropbox; compact social state belongs in GitHub.

watchSources.role: User's own occasional posts; primary inbound signal.

youtubeSourcePolicy: Followed creator channels are kept as source links. The feed does not silently scrape or poll them; the user brings an occasional post or video by link, then one member responds to that shared item.
personalityReferencePolicy: User-designated profiles are creative voice references for fictional characters. Attach individual public posts before deriving account-specific style observations. Do not infer private traits; preserve existing character canon; adapt broad voice patterns into original dialogue.
